body.x: Anyractive Co., Ltd. (Lim Sung-Hyun), participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. for total of four days from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan.(local time) and showed an IoT electronic board solution, ‘GoTouch’.

‘BEST OF MIK(MADE IN KOREA) CES TOP10’ selected only 10 companies among CES 2018 domestic exhibitors by global news network, Aving news and foreign news reporters from USA, China and other countries considering technological trend and growth potential of the companies. Each media will make a final evaluation during the CES exhibition and select the TOP3 for official announcement.

‘GoTouch’ solution from Anyractive is an electronic board applied IoT, which consist of an infrared sensor, a pen and an app. This enables users to use their TV or monitor, and beam projector screen as touch screen, so it is possible to convey with instant display and drawing, which is fast and direct, and to communicate more clearly and visually.

Since it utilizes the existing equipment, it has high cost cutting effect and is also effective because any screen from 4 inch to 100 inch can be used as an electronic board with only one ‘GoTouch’. In addition, it supports a collaboration function that allows users to share a screen in real time regardless of time and place.

Anyractive received more than 600% crowdfunding including ‘Kickstarter’ and ‘Indiegogo’, which are the US crowdfunding platforms last year, which confirmed its potential in the global market. Anyractive won the grand prize of WEnnovation from Samsung Electronics as well as a Minister prize of Ministry of Science and ICT from education office and a public institution and etc. in Korea, it is recognized as a possibility of development at home and aboard.

On the other hand, CES, the largest IT exhibition in the world, is held every January as sponsored by the American Consumer Technology Association(CTA), an exhibition to be able to understand the trends of the tech and consumer electronics industry of the world at one sight.

Aving News, which has the most reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, the world’s top three tech exhibition for the last 11 years, dispatches special news reporters to CES this year as well, report major issues in the world market and introduces Korea’s major companies all over the world.
